caseNameFull: Exxon Corp. v. United States Marathon Petroleum Co. v. United States Air Transport Association of America v. United States Philadelphia Electric Co. v. United States and National Freight, Inc. v. United States

opinions.text: Temp. Emerg. Ct. App. Motion of Chamber of Commerce of the United States for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in No. 85-429 granted. Motion of American Petroleum Institute for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae in Nos. 85-429 and 85-430 granted. Certiorari denied. Reported below: 773 F. 2d 1240.
